metadata.title: SohappyPDF
metadata.description: Convert PDFs and images with a simple workflow and a public API.

hero.title: PDF conversion that stays simple for people and APIs.
hero.description: Upload a file, choose a conversion, and download the result. The same workflow is available in the dashboard and through the public API.

demo.title: From upload to download
demo.description: The product workflow is the same in the dashboard: upload a file, choose a conversion, wait for processing, then download the result.

features.title: What you can do today
features.description: SohappyPDF converts supported files in the cloud and keeps the history in your account.

conversion.title: PDF conversion
conversion.description: Convert PDFs to Word, images, or text. Split or compress a PDF when you need a different PDF result.

workflow.title: Simple file workflow
workflow.description: Upload one file, choose an output, and download it when the conversion completes.

history.title: Conversion history
history.description: Review past conversions and download completed files from your account.

api.title: Developer API
api.description: Call the same file and conversion workflow with an API key.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Create and revoke keys in the dashboard. The raw key is shown only once.

limits.title: Predictable limits
limits.description: Free and Pro plans publish monthly conversion, storage, file size, and API limits.

security.title: Private files
security.description: Files belong to your account. Downloads use short-lived signed access.

cloud.title: Cloud processing
cloud.description: Conversions run in the cloud, so you do not install conversion software locally.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Send a supported file from the dashboard or the API.

convert.title: Convert
convert.description: Choose an available conversion. Processing continues in the background.

download.title: Download
download.description: Download the result when the conversion is complete.

developer.title: An API for the same product
developer.description: Create an API key, authenticate with a Bearer token, then upload, convert, and download through the public v1 API.
developer.authHint: Use Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY. Do not put keys in URLs or browser code.

security.title: Security properties we actually provide
security.description: These are product controls, not third-party compliance certifications.

authentication.title: Secure authentication
authentication.description: The dashboard uses email and password authentication before account data is shown.

privateFiles.title: Private files
privateFiles.description: Uploaded and converted files are scoped to the signed-in account or API key owner.

authorization.title: Server-side authorization
authorization.description: File, conversion, and API key actions are authorized on the server.

signedAccess.title: Signed result access
signedAccess.description: Downloads are issued as short-lived signed URLs rather than public object links.

apiKeys.title: API key protection
apiKeys.description: Keys are secrets. Revoke a leaked key in the dashboard and create a replacement.

pricing.title: Free and Pro plans
pricing.description: Limits come from the same plan catalog the product enforces.
pricing.note: Pro upgrades use the existing Polar checkout after you sign in. This page does not invent a price.

free.name: Free
free.summary: Start converting with a monthly allowance.

pro.name: Pro
pro.summary: More conversions, storage, file size, and API capacity.

toolsDirectory.title: PDF tools
toolsDirectory.description: Every public tool is a focused workflow. Pick a category, open a tool, upload a file, and download the result.

categories.organize: Combine, split, and rearrange PDF pages.
categories.convert: Turn PDFs into other formats and back again.
categories.edit: Add watermarks, page numbers, and light edits.
categories.optimize: Compress, repair, and prepare PDFs for sharing.
categories.security: Protect, unlock, and control access to PDFs.
categories.document: Convert Office files and images to PDF.
categories.intelligence: OCR, summarize, and translate document content.

privacy.title: Files and retention
privacy.body: Uploaded files are used to run this tool. Temporary files are kept for about {hours} hours, then they become eligible for removal. Downloads use short-lived signed links. We do not claim compliance certifications.

how.question: How do I use this tool?
how.answer: Upload a supported file, start processing, then download the result when it is ready. An account is not required unless the tool says it is.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.anonymous: No. You can run this tool without creating an account. A free account is optional if you want history and higher limits.
account.required: Yes. Sign in before processing so the file can be stored in your workspace.

limits.question: What are the current limits?
limits.answer: Up to {files} files, {sizeMb} MB each. Files are kept for about {hours} hours.

privacy.question: How long are files kept?
privacy.answer: Files are kept for about {hours} hours for processing and download, then they become eligible for removal.
